'''Battle Group Turak''' was an [[assault regiment]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] assigned to [[Battle of Turak IV|assault]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at [[Turak IV]]. Commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maltaz]], Battle Group Turak was comprised of two [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] of Army infantry and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and two battalions of the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]].
